section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Body Dissatisfaction measure, a figure rating scale developed by Pulvers and colleagues, outlining its use for assessing current, personal ideal, cultural ideal, and typical peer body sizes. It references findings from Webb et al. (2014) in a sample of Black older adolescent females, reporting mean body size discrepancy scores. The section concludes by noting the measure's strong psychometric properties but highlights its lack of evaluation in clinical samples.
